name: flowbio
description: Query Flow (flow.bio) — pipelines, samples, projects, executions, and data files via the Flow REST API; create projects and edit samples and their metadata; import public samples by accession, or curate a published study's samples and their metadata, each value with its source, for you to approve before importing them; run pipelines (kick off an execution and optionally poll it); plus generic data-file, demultiplexed-sample, and multiplexed (reads + annotation sheet) upload. Authenticates automatically when ~/.config/flow/api-token is present.
